svg.title: Compare Retained Fees, Not Asset Prices
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-specialist-retained-fee-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Fees, Not Asset Prices; subtitle: Five independent commission illustrations per $1,000,000 of closed asset value.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric bars show retained commission dollars on a common $1,000,000 underlying transaction denominator. Rates are negotiated planning assumptions, not published market averages or promised yields. Bars are alternatives, not components of the Base-Case revenue model. All examples assume no outside-broker share and no separately modeled settlement charge.; caption: Choose a niche using accessible mandates, required licenses, diligence workload, and closing probability. A higher fee rate can still produce weaker annual economics if transactions stall.; stages: label: Operating-business asset sale; value: $50,000 retained at an illustrative five-percent fee.; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: A negotiated 5% commission on a $1,000,000 asset sale yields $50,000. Validate business-opportunity licensing where applicable; use independent escrow and resolve purchase-price allocation before settlement.; label: Private-company control sale; value: $30,000 retained at an illustrative three-percent fee.; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: A negotiated 3% commission on a $1,000,000 control transaction yields $30,000. Document securities registration or exemption analysis, buyer control, active management, and settlement without broker custody.; label: Industrial real property; value: $25,000 retained at an illustrative two-and-a-half-percent fee.; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: A negotiated 2.5% commission on a $1,000,000 property sale yields $25,000. Perform brokerage through the required licensed structure and route proceeds through the designated title or escrow closing provider.; label: Specialist production equipment; value: $20,000 retained at an illustrative two-percent fee.; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: A negotiated 2% commission on a $1,000,000 equipment package yields $20,000. Match serial numbers to inspection reports, search applicable lien records, and obtain secured-party releases tied to settlement.; label: Commercial aircraft asset; value: $15,000 retained at an illustrative one-and-a-half-percent fee.; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: A negotiated 1.5% commission on a $1,000,000 aircraft sale yields $15,000. Use aviation-specific title and escrow expertise, verify recorded interests and maintenance records, and resolve applicable registration requirements.

text.title: Compare Retained Fees, Not Asset Prices
text.tspan: Compare Retained Fees, Not Asset Prices

circle.title: label: Operating-business asset sale; value: $50,000 retained at an illustrative five-percent fee.; numeric value: 50000.0; detail: A negotiated 5% commission on a $1,000,000 asset sale yields $50,000. Validate business-opportunity licensing where applicable; use independent escrow and resolve purchase-price allocation before settlement.

label: Private-company control sale; value: $30,000 retained at an illustrative three-percent fee.; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: A negotiated 3% commission on a $1,000,000 control transaction yields $30,000. Document securities registration or exemption analysis, buyer control, active management, and settlement without broker custody.

label: Industrial real property; value: $25,000 retained at an illustrative two-and-a-half-percent fee.; numeric value: 25000.0; detail: A negotiated 2.5% commission on a $1,000,000 property sale yields $25,000. Perform brokerage through the required licensed structure and route proceeds through the designated title or escrow closing provider.

label: Specialist production equipment; value: $20,000 retained at an illustrative two-percent fee.; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: A negotiated 2% commission on a $1,000,000 equipment package yields $20,000. Match serial numbers to inspection reports, search applicable lien records, and obtain secured-party releases tied to settlement.

label: Commercial aircraft asset; value: $15,000 retained at an illustrative one-and-a-half-percent fee.; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: A negotiated 1.5% commission on a $1,000,000 aircraft sale yields $15,000. Use aviation-specific title and escrow expertise, verify recorded interests and maintenance records, and resolve applicable registration requirements.
